अङ्क्, i. 10 (rather a denominat. derived from अङ्क), Par. and i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To mark, Pañc. 46, 8.
 2. To adorn,
. To brand,
. To stigmatise,

Bhartṛ. 2, 44.
 5
. † To go.

अङ्क, i. e. अञ्च् + अ, m.
 1. A hook.
 2. A mark.
 3. A cipher.
 4. An act in a drama.
 5. The flank.
 6. The lap.
 7. The arm, Vikr. d. 147.
 8. Proximity,
Bhartṛ. 2, 23

.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ἄγκη, ἀγκών, ἀγκύλος, ὄγκος; [] Lat. uncus; O.H.G. ango, anga, angul; A.S. angel, etc.
अङ्क-भाज् (vb. भज्), adj. Approaching,

अङ्कुर (from अञ्च्, cf. अङ्क), m.
 1. A shoot, or sprout, Pañc. i. d. 251.
 2. Intumescence.
 --Comp.
अङ्कुरित, i. e. अङ्कुर + इत, adj. Furnished with shoots, Vikr. d. 12.

अङ्कुश, i. e. अङ्कु (in the Ved. अङ्कूय from अञ्च्, cf. अङ्क) + श, m. and n.
 1. A hook.
 2. A goad for driving elephants with.
 --Comp.
अङ्कोठ, and अङ्कोल अङ्कोल, m. A plant, Alangium hexapetalum.
+ ग्रह अङ्कुश- + ग्रह, m. a mahout, or elephant's driver,
+ पाल अङ्क- + पाल, f. ली, embrace.
अङ्क-पाली, f. embrace.
+ बन्ध अङ्क- + बन्ध, m. branding with a dishonouring mark, Yājñ. 2, 294.
+ वश अङ्कुश- + वश, adj. obeying the goad of an elephant, Pañc. i. d. 373.
